title: Decoupled Execution & Control,
Durable Long-Horizon Tasks.
diagnostics.description: Decouples task orchestration, model gateway, and shared memory layers to ensure production reliability, complete data sovereignty, and multi-tenant isolation.
features: DS Bot + DSH Role Scheduling: Spawns lightweight stdio workers, handling background runs and human-in-the-loop gates
QMD MCP Shared Memory: Sub-millisecond SQLite/PostgreSQL vector and context search for all agent executors
AI Aggregator Gateway: Unified authentication, quota management, and multi-channel failover routing
XConnect Mesh: Low-latency event streaming to XWorkmate clients with WebRTC remote interactive takeover
